psychological_meaning: Goblin, a muted shade of green, evokes feelings of nature, growth, and a touch of mystery. It suggests stability and endurance, while also hinting at the hidden and unknown aspects of the natural world. It represents balance and harmony, often associated with healing and renewal, but with an earthy, grounded quality that prevents it from being overly idealistic.
